response.query: Generate a scintific personality traits description of this real-world scientist : Jingyu Li is a leading researcher on corporate risk perceptions and systemic financial risk. Her work focuses on how uniform risk views impact financial stability. She is highly cited in this field.
response.answer: Jingyu Li is a leading researcher on corporate risk perceptions and systemic financial risk. She is highly cited in her field and currently an assistant professor at Beijing University of Technology. Her work focuses on how uniform risk views impact financial stability.
